privacy.intro: This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal data in accordance with Vietnam's Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on personal data protection.

sections.title: 1. Data we collect
sections.body: Account details (name, email, phone), floor-plan images you upload for AI processing, and contact/lead form submissions. We do not collect land-title (deed) documents.

sections.title: 2. How we use data
sections.body: To provide the design and estimate services, respond to your requests, and improve the platform.

sections.title: 3. Image data
sections.body: Uploaded floor-plan images are used only to generate drawings and renders. They are stored securely and can be deleted on request.

sections.title: 4. Data sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your personal data. AI processing may involve trusted providers under confidentiality obligations.

sections.title: 5. Your rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time.

sections.title: 6. Contact
sections.body: For privacy requests, please contact us via the channels listed on the contact section.

payment.title: Payments & Refunds
payment.updated: Last updated: sample content — BuildX will provide the official text before go-live.
payment.intro: This policy explains how you pay for packages on the platform, how we confirm payments and when you are entitled to a refund.

sections.title: 1. Payment method
sections.body: Design and supervision packages are paid by bank transfer using the QR code shown at the Payment step. Keep the transfer note (your order code) unchanged so the system can reconcile it automatically.

sections.title: 2. Payment confirmation
sections.body: After you transfer, the order waits for confirmation. Packages are usually activated within minutes; if it is not activated within 24 working hours, contact support with your order code.

sections.title: 3. Invoices
sections.body: E-invoices are issued with the buyer details you entered at the Order confirmation step. You can review orders and invoices under My account.

sections.title: 4. When you get a refund
sections.body: You are refunded when: you transferred twice or more than the order value; the order was not activated because of a platform error; or you cancel within 7 days of payment without using any of the package's credits.

sections.title: 5. When refunds do not apply
sections.body: Credits already used (design options, lookups, completed inspections) are not refunded. Gifts bundled with a package cannot be exchanged for cash.

sections.title: 6. Refund process
sections.body: Send a request through support with your order code and reason. We reply within 2 working days and refund to the paying account within 7–10 working days after approval.

sections.title: 7. Contact
sections.body: For any payment or refund question, use the contact channels at the bottom of the page.

form.rolesPlaceholder: Pick one or more staff roles
form.rolesHint: Only staff roles are listed; the Customer role cannot be assigned to staff.

password.title: Password for the new account
password.warning: This password is shown ONCE. Copy it and hand it to the staff member through a private channel now; once you close this box it cannot be retrieved.
password.label: Generated password
password.copyFailed: Could not copy. Please select and copy it manually.

confirm.lockBody: The account is locked immediately and all sessions are revoked. Roles and assignments are kept.
confirm.unlockBody: The staff member can sign in again with the same roles and assignments as before the lock.
confirm.forceLogoutBody: Revoke all open sessions so new permissions take effect immediately. The account stays active, not locked.
confirm.revokeBody: If after revoking the staff member still supervises packages but loses the completion permission, the system will reject it.

rolesDrawer.hint: A staff member's permissions are the union of all roles they hold.
rolesDrawer.noRoles: This staff member holds no roles yet.

feedback.locked: Account locked and all sessions revoked.
feedback.lockedWithAssignments: Account locked. This person still supervises {count} package(s) that need reassigning.
feedback.forcedLogout: All sessions for the account have been revoked.

consultants.description: 1:1 architect profiles. Only Visible architects appear on the booking screen. Architects are never deleted — only hidden.
consultants.name: Full name
consultants.title: Job title
consultants.specialtiesHint: Pick or type a new specialty. The first one is the main specialty.
consultants.ratingReadOnly: Rating and review count are aggregated by the system, not entered by hand.
consultants.introHint: Up to 1,000 characters. The first line is used as the short card description.
consultants.yearsRule: Years of experience must be a whole number from 0.
consultants.hideWarning: {count} upcoming bookings remain. Hiding only stops new bookings — existing bookings are not cancelled or reassigned.
consultants.hiddenWithBookings: Hidden but {count} bookings still to run
consultants.scheduleHint: Click a slot to toggle Unavailable. Booked slots cannot be reopened. Locking a day or session never cancels bookings — handle them on the Bookings screen first.
consultants.lockBlocked: This day or session still has bookings — handle them before locking.
consultants.slotFull: This slot is booked — it cannot be reopened.
consultants.slotRangeClosed: The whole day or session is unavailable — reopen it first.
consultants.affected: {count} bookings this day — handle them before locking

bookings.description: Bookings made on the 1:1 consultation page. Call the customer back within 24 business hours, agree with the architect, then Confirm; once the slot has ended, mark it Completed. Reject with a reason if you cannot take it.
bookings.rejectReasonRequired: Please enter a reason so the customer knows why.
bookings.slotClosed: This slot is locked (Unavailable) — check the architect schedule.
bookings.slotTakenBy: The architect already has confirmed booking {code} in this slot.
bookings.nearWarning: The booking is about to start or overdue — please check before rejecting.

customers.description: Customer accounts. Plans, credits, orders, transactions and Ban / Unban live on the detail page.
customers.name: Full name
customers.banWarning: A banned account cannot sign in or use features that require signing in. Plans, credits, orders and transactions are kept.
customers.unbanNote: Unbanning does not change the plan, expiry or credits.
customers.detailDescription: Read-only. Plans and credits follow the purchased order snapshot — admins cannot change plans, expiry, credits or activation.
customers.packagesReadOnly: Monitoring only — admins do not activate, re-activate or edit plans, expiry or credits.

transactions.description: The payment ledger — read only. Search by code / name / email; filter by status, plan and method.

invitations.description: One row per contractor the customer invited, with the survey time they chose. Search by invitation code, project, customer or contractor. The Survey block is internal; the Progress bar is what the customer sees — hover a step to read its customer-facing text.
invitations.revertConfirmBody: Use this after a mistake. The current step is removed from the timeline the customer sees.
invitations.rejectHint: The invitation becomes Rejected and closes; the survey slot is released. The customer sees the status and reason.
invitations.noDossier: No dossier snapshot for this invitation (sent before dossiers were stored with invitations).

inspections.description: Projects whose customers bought a supervision plan, with the owner to call when needed. Once the engineer has inspected, press "Confirm stage": the stage file locks and the next stage opens. After that it can only change through a change request.
inspections.pendingUpload: Customer has not uploaded the completion dossier
inspections.pendingUploadBody: The customer has not marked this stage complete. Confirming now still locks the dossier.
inspections.engineerRequired: Enter the name of the confirming engineer.
inspections.onSiteHint: On counts one site visit against the package; off means a remote dossier review only.
inspections.noteRequired: Enter the inspection result — the customer reads this exact line.
inspections.notePlaceholder: E.g. Rebar and formwork match the drawings, ready for the concrete pour.
inspections.lockNote: Once confirmed the stage dossier is locked; any later change must go through a change request (R5).
inspections.confirmedToast: Stage "{stage}" confirmed and the next stage opened.

inbox.description: Everything someone is waiting on, in priority order. Click a row to open that screen already filtered to the work.

invitations.title: Invitations & surveys to handle
invitations.hint: Invitations nobody has picked up yet, or survey times not yet agreed with contractor and customer.

inspections.title: Stages awaiting supervisor sign-off
inspections.hint: Customer uploaded stage files — engineer checks, then locks the stage.

changeRequests.title: Change requests to review
changeRequests.hint: Customer asks to amend a locked stage.

contractors.title: Unverified contractors
contractors.hint: Check licences and the partnership contract, then mark verified.

orders.description: Look up plan orders. Price, discount, total and payment status are set by the system at order time — read-only.

surveys.description: Customers pick a survey time when inviting a contractor; the survey itself happens off the website. Call the contractor to lock the time, call the customer to confirm, then update the status here.

modalHint.confirm: You called {contractor} and the customer ({phone}); both agreed on this time.
modalHint.reschedule: Pick the new time both sides agreed on by phone. The survey needs confirming again afterwards.
modalHint.cancel: Cancel the survey with {contractor}. Record why, for when the customer calls.

surveys.opsNotePlaceholder: Who you called, when, what was agreed…

changeRequests.description: Customers asking to amend a locked stage. Approve and the stage moves to a new version; reject and the locked version stays. The customer's dashboard updates immediately.
changeRequests.approveHint: Approve: the stage moves to {version} and the customer can add files.
changeRequests.responseRequired: Explain to the customer why it was rejected.

contractors.description: New contractors start Hidden and Not accepting projects. Project counts and legal status are computed by the system. Projects, legal documents and BuildX partnership are managed on the detail page.
contractors.name: Contractor name
contractors.detailDescription: Admin profile of the contractor. Contractor, project, legal and partnership verification are independent statuses.
contractors.kindHint: Line shown under the name, e.g. Construction contractor. Not used for filtering or matching.
contractors.foundedRule: Year from 1900 and not after the current year.
contractors.nonNegativeInt: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
contractors.specialtiesHint: Pick or type a new specialty.
contractors.buildingTypesHint: Only Active types can be newly selected.
contractors.photosHint: Three fixed slots, one image each; all three are optional.
contractors.surveyRule: Enter a whole number of hours above 0.
contractors.hideWarning: The contractor still has {count} unfinished invitations / surveys. Hiding only stops new recommendations — nothing is cancelled.
contractors.visibleNeedsCapability: Add at least one specialty, building type and construction scope before making the profile visible.
contractors.deleteBlocked: This contractor has projects, verification, invitations or a partnership — hide it instead of deleting.
contractors.verifyHint: Verification requires every condition below. It does not make the profile visible.

gaps.capability: Specialty, building type and scope set

contractors.licenseExpiredWarning: The business licence is no longer valid — the legal profile is no longer shown as verified. Update it with valid details and review it again.

discounts.description: Codes customers enter on the order confirmation screen. The rules are shared with checkout, so what you set here is exactly what customers get. "Used" counts paid orders.
discounts.codeRule: Up to 50 characters: unaccented letters, digits, hyphen or underscore, no spaces.
discounts.periodHint: Start and end days are included. Leave one side empty for no limit.
discounts.codeLocked: The code has been used — its text can no longer change.
discounts.percentRange: A percentage must be above 0 and at most 100.
discounts.limitBelowUsed: Total uses cannot be below uses so far ({used}).
discounts.perAccountAboveTotal: Uses per email cannot exceed total uses.
discounts.endBeforeStart: The end date cannot be before the start date.
discounts.deleteBlocked: The code has been used — it can only be turned off.
discounts.deleteConfirm: Delete code {code}? Uses so far: {used}. This cannot be undone.

bmtPlans.description: Design plans (sold monthly / yearly) and supervision plans (sold per construction site). Editing a plan edits its draft — the website only changes when you Publish. Purchased plans keep the version locked at purchase.
bmtPlans.publishConfirmBody: The draft becomes the public version and the plan goes on sale. Periods / packages customers already bought are unchanged.
bmtPlans.stopConfirmBody: The plan disappears from the website and no new orders can be created. Purchased plans keep their benefits and term. Stopped plans cannot be put back on sale yet.
bmtPlans.name: Plan name
bmtPlans.stoppedNote: This plan is stopped: you can still save a draft but it cannot be published again yet.
bmtPlans.draftNote: Saving overwrites the whole draft; the website keeps showing the published version until you Publish from the plan row.
bmtPlans.codeHint: Must be unique and cannot change after creation.
bmtPlans.kindHint: Chosen once at creation, cannot change later.
bmtPlans.serviceDescriptionHint: Required to publish. Display only, locked per order — creates no uses or counters.
bmtPlans.consultationHint: Free text describing the offline consultation service; creates no consultation uses or levels.
bmtPlans.priceRule: Price must be a whole VND amount greater than 0.
bmtPlans.yearOptionalPlaceholder: Leave blank if not sold yearly
bmtPlans.quotaHint: Enter the monthly quota (and yearly if sold yearly), or tick ∞ for unlimited. An empty cell means the plan does not include that benefit. Yearly is not 12× monthly automatically.
bmtPlans.limitRule: Enter at least 1 use, or choose unlimited.
bmtPlans.displayBenefitsHint: Shared by month and year. Not added or switched off both mean no access. A design plan needs at least one benefit (usage-based or on / off) to be published.
bmtPlans.noBooleanDefinitions: The system catalogue has no on / off benefits yet.
bmtPlans.sortOrderRule: Order must be a whole number.
bmtPlans.supervisionNote: Supervision plans use no benefit catalogue and no consultation text; publishing needs a name, price and service description.
bmtPlans.snapshotNote: Existing orders keep the plan version at order time — published changes apply to later purchases only.
bmtPlans.cardNote: Cover image, highlight label and gift shown on the plan card on the website. All optional.
bmtPlans.coverImageHint: Click Upload image to pick a cover; leave empty if none.
bmtPlans.highlightLabelHint: Text shown on the badge when the plan is highlighted (e.g. Best seller).

bmtCommerce.ordersDescription: Every customer plan order: pending, underpaid, expired, canceled, paid. Status is matched by the system from bank transactions — lookup only, no manual confirmation.
bmtCommerce.purchasesDescription: One row per purchase that was granted a package. Open details for term, usage, history and cancel / complete / unassign actions (requires the matching permission).
bmtCommerce.transactionsDescription: Every SePay transaction received by the system, including ones not matched to an order — read-only, no manual matching.
bmtCommerce.orderingDiscrepancyHint: A late payment reversed the order against an already granted design purchase — handle outside the system.
bmtCommerce.transactionsBlock: Bank transactions matched to this order

lifecycle.cancelBody: This is final and cannot be undone. No refund, used uses are not returned; canceling a supervision package ends its assignment.
lifecycle.completeTitle: Mark this supervision package as completed?
lifecycle.completeBody: The package stays attached to and keeps its slot on the site. It can be reopened later.
lifecycle.unassignTitle: Remove this supervision package from its site?
lifecycle.unassignBody: Only possible before the original assignment deadline. The package returns to Not assigned, keeping its owner and deadline; the customer reassigns it.

supervisionPackages.description: The three construction-management options on the Supervision plans page. Edit only — the plan picker and the dashboard refer to exactly these three. New prices apply to new orders only.
supervisionPackages.name: Package name
supervisionPackages.inspectionsRule: Inspections must be a whole number from 1.

contractorsAdmin.description: Manage contractor profiles: info, capability (building type × scope), contact, legal. New profiles are Hidden; going Visible needs name + address + coordinates + ≥1 building type + ≥1 scope.
contractorsAdmin.name: Contractor name
contractorsAdmin.ratingHint: Admin-entered score, 0–5. Leave both score and count empty to hide the rating.
contractorsAdmin.contactNote: Contact details are admin-only and never shown on the public site.
contractorsAdmin.deleteConfirmBody: Deletes the profile, projects, legal info and images of this contractor. This cannot be undone.

projects.title: Portfolio projects
projects.hint: Each project needs one building type, one scope and at least one image.
projects.name: Project name
projects.needImage: At least one image is required.
projects.classificationHint: Floors and rooftop enclosure follow the building type configuration in the estimate catalog.
projects.notApplicable: Not applicable to this building type
projects.categoryError: Unable to load classification options. Your input has been preserved.

contractorsAdmin.addressHint: Pick a suggestion to auto-fill latitude/longitude; you can still edit them below.

files.scanHint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 20 MB.
files.savedNote: Files you just uploaded are kept only when you press Save; if you abandon the form the system cleans them up after 24 hours.

kindHint.Logo: One image. JPG/PNG/WebP, up to 10 MB.
kindHint.Cover: One image. JPG/PNG/WebP, up to 10 MB.
kindHint.Office: A set of up to 50. JPG/PNG/WebP, 10 MB each.
kindHint.Team: A set of up to 50. JPG/PNG/WebP, 10 MB each.

problem.dateOrder: The expiry date cannot be before the issue date.

licenses.fixBeforeSave: Fix the licenses that show errors before saving.

partnership.hint: Current BuildX partnership. Leave everything empty for no partnership section.
partnership.dateOrder: The end date cannot be before the start date.

errors.UnsupportedType: This file type is not accepted. Images: JPG, PNG or WebP; scans: PDF, JPG or PNG.
errors.TooLarge: The file exceeds the allowed size (images 10 MB, scans 20 MB).
errors.StoragePutFailed: Could not send the file to storage, please retry.
errors.StillValidating: The file is still being checked, try again shortly.
errors.Rejected: The file failed verification (wrong format or corrupt). Pick another file.
errors.Expired: This upload has expired, pick the file again.
errors.InvalidMediaUpload: Invalid file: wrong format, too large or the content does not match the file type.
errors.MediaUploadNotReady: The file has not reached storage yet, please retry.
errors.MediaUploadExpired: This upload has expired, pick the file again.
errors.MediaStorageUnavailable: File storage is not ready. Please tell the tech team.
errors.MediaIdempotencyConflict: Duplicate upload request. Pick the file again.
errors.MediaUploadLeaseLost: The file check was interrupted, please retry.
errors.MediaImageNotReady: The file is not verified yet so it cannot be attached. Try again shortly.
errors.MediaImageGone: This file has been cleaned up from storage. Upload it again.
errors.MediaReferenceUnavailable: Could not attach the file to the profile right now. Please retry.
errors.ContractorVersionConflict: The profile was just changed by someone else. Close the drawer, reopen the profile and try again.
errors.ContractorProfileIncomplete: The profile is missing required information to be visible (name, address, coordinates, at least one building type and one scope).
errors.InvalidContractorInput: The profile data is invalid. Check the fields (coordinates, dates, rating, file types).
errors.InvalidContractorProject: A project needs a name, exactly one building type, one scope and at least one image.
errors.ContractorCategoryUnavailable: The selected building type or scope is no longer available. Pick again.
errors.ContractorFileUnavailable: File storage is unavailable. Please tell the tech team.
errors.ContractorAssetInUse: This file is still used by the profile so it cannot be deleted yet.
errors.ContractorNotFound: Contractor profile not found (it may have been deleted).
errors.ContractorProjectNotFound: This project was not found in the profile.
errors.AccessForbidden: Only admin accounts can manage contractors.
errors.generic: Could not upload the file. Please retry.
errors.LocationDatasetChanged: The location list has changed. Reload and select the address again.
errors.DependencyUnavailable: The data source is unavailable. Please try again.

contractorsAdmin.provinceHint: Select the company’s province to determine its region. You can add it later.
contractorsAdmin.provinceLoadError: Could not load provinces. Reopen the form to try again.

addressParts.streetPlaceholder: Enter a house number and street to find the location
addressParts.mapHint: Select an address suggestion to show the map. The location will be saved automatically with the address.
addressParts.mapAdjust: Drag the pin or click the map to adjust the exact location.
addressParts.searchTooLong: The full address exceeds the map search limit of 500 characters. Shorten the house number/street and select the location again.
addressParts.noResult: No location found. Check the address and try again.
addressParts.mapError: Unable to find the location. Please try again.
addressParts.coordinatesRequired: Select an address suggestion to determine the location before saving.
addressParts.required: Enter the province/city, ward/commune and house number/street.
addressParts.tooLong: House number/street must not exceed 500 characters.
addressParts.catalogError: Unable to load provinces/wards. Your input has been preserved.
addressParts.selectAgain: Select the address from the new location list

paymentConnections.description: Configure the SePay receiving bank accounts, split into Test/Live environments. Each environment has exactly one active connection. Secrets are set on the server by ops, not here.
paymentConnections.gatewayHint: The bank name SePay uses (e.g. Vietcombank).
paymentConnections.subAccountHint: Leave blank if not using a virtual account.
paymentConnections.qrBankCodeHint: Bank code used to build the transfer QR image.
paymentConnections.setActiveConfirmTitle: Set as the active connection for {env}?
paymentConnections.setActiveConfirmBody: Only accepts an enabled connection in the same environment with a secret on the server.
paymentConnections.secretNote: The webhook secret is set on the server by ops per secretConfigKeys — not configured on this screen.
paymentConnections.accountLockedNote: This connection already has orders or transactions, so the receiving-account fields (bank, account number, VA, QR code) cannot change. You can still enable or disable it.
paymentConnections.secretOk: The secret is configured on the server — it can be selected as the active connection.
paymentConnections.secretMissing: No secret on the server yet — it cannot be selected as the active connection.
paymentConnections.webhookPathHint: Paste into the SePay webhook settings, appended to the API server address.
paymentConnections.secretKeysHint: Operations set these variables on the backend server: {n} is an arbitrary index, ConnectionId is the connection ID above, WebhookSecret is the SePay secret.
paymentConnections.createNote: After creating, ask operations to set the secret on the server using the keys shown when you reopen this connection. Without a secret it cannot be selected as the active connection.

accessAudit.description: Log of every role, permission and assignment change — read-only, append-only. Includes rejected attempts.

constructionScopes.description: Construction scope catalog shared by contractor profiles and portfolio projects. Names must be unique; an "Inactive" scope can't be newly attached but keeps existing links. A scope in use can't be deleted.
constructionScopes.name: Scope name
constructionScopes.deleteConfirmBody: Can only be deleted when no contractor or project uses this scope.

estimateCatalog.buildingTypesDescription: Building types used by Create estimate and the template library. Each type separately enables floor choice, tum choice and the two style groups. Saving only affects new estimates; existing estimates keep their configuration.
estimateCatalog.architectureDescription: Architecture styles customers pick when creating an estimate. Each style has a name and one image; assign styles to building types on the Building types screen.
estimateCatalog.interiorDescription: Interior styles customers pick when creating an estimate. Each style has a name and one image; assign styles to building types on the Building types screen.
estimateCatalog.floorsEnabled: Let customers choose the number of floors
estimateCatalog.floorsEmpty: Floor choice is on — add at least one floor count.
estimateCatalog.tumEnabled: Let customers choose with / without tum
estimateCatalog.tumHint: Tum is an on / off flag only, with no list.
estimateCatalog.architectureEnabled: Let customers choose an architecture style
estimateCatalog.architectureEmpty: Architecture styles are on — assign at least one style.
estimateCatalog.interiorEnabled: Let customers choose an interior style
estimateCatalog.interiorEmpty: Interior styles are on — assign at least one style.
estimateCatalog.keptWhileDisabled: Turning a group off keeps its list, so it comes back when turned on again. Customers only see groups that are on.
estimateCatalog.versionNote: The catalogue is versioned: every save creates a new version for new estimates. If someone else just saved, you will get a conflict — close the drawer and reopen it to load the latest.
estimateCatalog.styleImageNote: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Click Upload image and pick a file; the system verifies and stores it.
estimateCatalog.styleAssignHint: Only building types with this group enabled are listed. To add a type whose group is off, enable it on the Building types screen.
estimateCatalog.httpsUrl: Must be a URL starting with https://, up to 2048 characters.

library.libraryDescription: The 2D and 3D template library. Add / Edit in one form: template details and images per section. Unpublished templates can be deleted; published ones use Show/Hide.
library.description2d: 2D drawing templates of the library. Templates are versioned: editing in place keeps the version; to release a new version, create a draft, edit it and publish.
library.description3d: 3D drawing templates of the library. Templates are versioned: editing in place keeps the version; to release a new version, create a draft, edit it and publish.
library.publishFlowNote: A new template is a draft and invisible to customers. Open "Manage versions" to add sections, upload images/files, pick a cover image and publish.
library.createNote: You can save a draft with incomplete data. Publishing needs: a name, drawing type, three dimensions, building type (plus floors / attic if that type uses them), architecture and interior styles (3D templates), at least one section with files, and a cover image (the first image is picked as the cover).
library.createImagesHint: Each group is a section — its name (Section 1, Section 2…) is shown to visitors, and a section can hold many images. JPG, PNG, WebP images up to 5 MB; PDF, DWG, DXF files are also accepted. Files upload when you press Save.
library.createImagesPartial: Template saved, but {count} file(s) could not be uploaded. Open "Edit" on this template to add them again.
library.name: Template name
library.draftHint: May be empty for a draft; required to publish.
library.areaHint: Entered separately; does not have to equal width × length.
library.decimal: {field} must be greater than 0 with at most two decimals (e.g. 5.25).
library.catalogUnavailable: Could not load the building type catalog (requires permission to manage the template library).
library.pinnedTypeNote: The pinned building type is no longer in the current catalogue. Editing only name, description or dimensions keeps the old classification; changing it requires the current catalogue.
library.visibilityNote: Hiding does not change versions; people who already have access keep it.
library.versionsHint: Editing the current version corrects it in place (same version number). Superseded versions are read-only. Only drafts can be deleted; hide published templates instead.
library.newDraftConfirm: Create a new draft from the current version?
library.newDraftNote: The draft copies details, classification, images, order and cover. Customers keep seeing the current version until you publish.
library.publishConfirm: Publish this draft as a new version?
library.publishNote: Customers will see the new version; the previous one is kept and locked. The template's visibility does not change.
library.editCurrentNote: You are editing the version customers see: changes apply immediately without a new version. The current version must stay complete.
library.readOnlyVersion: This version has been superseded — view only.
library.detachConfirm: Remove this file from the version?
library.detachNote: The file in storage is not deleted. The current version cannot lose its cover image or the last file of a section customers can already see.
library.uploadMissing: No upload button yet: upload the file to storage first, then paste its https URL here.
library.originalNameHint: Leave empty to use the name from the URL.
library.styles3dNote: A 3D template needs at least one style in every group the building type enables before it can be published.
library.stylesNeedType: Pick a building type first to see the applicable styles.

sections.intro: Every image and file of a template lives in a section (content group) that you name yourself. A section without files is "in preparation" and stays hidden from customers until its first file arrives.
sections.setFirstAsCover: Automatically use the first uploaded image as the cover if the version has none
sections.empty: No sections yet. Add a section, then upload files into it.
sections.reloaded: Someone else just changed this — data was reloaded, please try again.
sections.uploadSkipped: Not uploaded because the batch was stopped.
sections.noFiles: This section has no files yet.
sections.uploadHint: Images: JPG, PNG, WebP up to 5 MB; files: PDF, DWG, DXF. Multiple files upload one at a time to avoid version conflicts.

errors.LibraryVersionConflict: Someone else just edited this version. Data was reloaded.
errors.LibraryVersionChanged: The version just changed. Data was reloaded.
errors.LibraryVersionReadOnly: This version has been replaced and is read-only.
errors.LibraryPositionConflict: That position is taken. Data was reloaded, please try again.
errors.IdempotencyConflict: This request clashes with another one. Reload the page and try again.
errors.MediaIdempotencyConflict: The upload request clashed. Pick the file again and retry.
errors.InvalidLibraryContent: The library content is not valid.
errors.LibraryNotFound: The template, version, section or upload was not found (it may have been deleted).
errors.LibraryStorageUnavailable: Library attachment storage (PDF/DWG/DXF) is not configured, so this file cannot be uploaded. Images still work. Please tell the tech team.
errors.MediaStorageUnavailable: Image storage is unavailable. Please tell the tech team.
errors.InvalidMediaUpload: The file failed verification (its real format or size does not match). Pick another file.
errors.MediaUploadNotReady: The file has not reached storage yet. Please retry.
errors.MediaUploadExpired: The upload expired. Pick the file again to re-upload.
errors.MediaUploadLeaseLost: File verification was interrupted. Pick the file again to re-upload.
errors.AccessForbidden: You do not have permission to manage the template library.

uploadErrors.unsupported: Only JPG/PNG/WebP images and PDF/DWG/DXF files are accepted.
uploadErrors.ticketExpired: The upload expired. Pick the file again to re-upload.
uploadErrors.storagePutFailed: Could not send the file to storage (network or storage refused). Please retry.
uploadErrors.stillValidating: The system is still verifying the file. Reload the page in a few minutes to see the result.
uploadErrors.rejected: The file failed verification. Pick another file.

sections.publishBlockedTitle: Cannot publish yet — content is incomplete

library.createUploading: Uploading images… {done}/{total} files. Don't close this window.
library.publishNowHint: When on, visitors see the template immediately. If required data is missing, the template is saved as a draft and the missing items are listed.
library.createNotPublished: Template saved as a draft, but it could not be published:
library.createFloorSavedHint: A saved section can't be removed — you can rename it or add/remove its images.
library.deleteConfirmBody: An unpublished template is deleted together with its sections and images. This cannot be undone.
library.publishedStillHidden: Published, but the template is still hidden from visitors. Use Change status to show it.
library.saveNewVersion: Save and release as a new version
library.saveNewVersionBody: The current version is kept in history and no longer shown to visitors; the new version replaces it. Visitors who viewed the old one need a new lookup to open the new one. A plain Save edits the current version in place and costs visitors nothing.

detail.noSections: This template has no sections yet.
detail.emptySection: This section has no files yet.

buildingTypes.description: Shared catalogue for project forms, contractor capabilities and 2D templates. The Floors and Attic settings decide which fields users see and whether they are required. Only Active types appear on new projects.
buildingTypes.name: Building type
buildingTypes.statusHint: New types start Inactive. They can be activated only when the Floors and Attic settings are valid.
buildingTypes.floorOptionsHint: Only Active options can be chosen. Add or rename options in the Floor options table below.
buildingTypes.disableWarning: Switching to Does not apply: new projects will no longer ask for this field. Existing projects keep their saved value.
buildingTypes.historyNote: Changes apply the next time a project is created or edited and never overwrite saved data.
buildingTypes.removedOptionImpact: Removing “{option}”: {count} projects currently use this option.
buildingTypes.deleteBlocked: This building type is in use — it can only be set to Inactive.
buildingTypes.deleteConfirm: Delete building type “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
buildingTypes.deactivateNote: Inactive types disappear from new project forms; existing projects keep the type they chose.

problems.floorsEmpty: Floors applies — choose at least one option before activating.
problems.floorInactive: An inactive floor option is selected — remove it before activating.
problems.defaultInvalid: The default option must be one of the allowed options.

floorOptions.title: Floor options
floorOptions.description: Shared list of options. Each building type picks the options it allows. Options in use cannot be deleted, only set to Inactive.
floorOptions.label: Option name

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: No. BuildX helps you find and connect with vetted contractors free of charge.
faq.q2: What do I need to start?
faq.a2: Just basic details about the build and what you need done. You can create a brief for free without buying a package.
faq.q3: How many contractors can I invite?
faq.a3: Up to <mark>3 contractors</mark> per project. The cap keeps every survey trackable instead of flooding you with calls.
faq.q4: Can I see quotes on the website?
faq.a4: Yes. BuildX shows a predicted price range so you can plan your budget. It is for reference only; the actual cost is quoted by the contractor after the survey.
faq.q5: Does BuildX do the building work?
faq.a5: No. BuildX does not carry out the construction itself; it acts as the link between you and suitable builders and material suppliers.
faq.q6: Can I track progress in the app?
faq.a6: Yes. Follow progress, photos and contractor updates right in the app, anytime, anywhere.
faq.q7: Are contractors in the app verified?
faq.a7: Yes. Every contractor's profile and capability is reviewed by BuildX before they can operate in the app.
